wilcox-oath.description: The new president takes the oath of office. The Wilcox home in which President Roosevelt was sworn in — 1 photomechanical print : halftone. | Group of people around front of porch draped with U.S. flag. — Creator: Dunn, Robert Lee — Date: 1901
wilcox-oath.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.

rushmore-highsmith.credit_line: Mount Rushmore National Memorial, South Dakota. Photograph by Carol M. Highsmith. Photographs in the Carol M. Highsmith Archive, Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
rushmore-highsmith.note: A modern photograph, deliberately: the only Rushmore images in the DAM are of the Library's own construction, and the LOC's period carving photographs are either undigitised or of uncertain rights. Highsmith dedicated her archive to the public domain.
